abstract: A case of unilateral gonadoblastoma in association with a ruptured ectopic tubal pregnancy is presented. The patient had normal menstrual history prior to a missed period followed by abdominal pain and the passage of clots. The surgical specimens, in addition to the ruptured tubal pregnancy, showed nodular foci of typical gonadoblastoma in the right ovary, the remainder of the ovarian tissue being normal. The left ovary was subsequently removed and examination revealed normal constituents without evidence of tumor. Cytogenetic evaluation of peripheral leukocytes showed cells with a normal female sex chromatin complement, 46-XX, as well as cells with 45 chromosomes in which one of the X chromosomes was missing.
abstract_ja: 月経遅延の後に腹痛と血塊の排出を来した患者で、破裂した卵管妊娠に併発した片側性性腺芽細胞腫の症例を報告する。手術標本では、破裂卵管妊娠に加え、右卵巣に典型的な性腺芽細胞腫の結節性病変を認め、卵巣の他の組織は正常であった。その後摘出された左卵巣には腫瘍性病変はみられなかった。末梢血白血球の染色体解析では、正常な女性の性染色体構成46,XXの細胞と、X染色体が1本欠損した45本の染色体を有する細胞が認められた。
